extensionDescription.message: Region, full-page, and scrolling screenshots with local annotation tools.

longHint.message: Lock the start, then extend the lower edge

shortcutHint.message: Focus the field and press a new key combination. Default: Alt+Shift+A. If Firefox, the OS, or another extension still owns it, choose another combination.

shortcutClearedHint.message: Shortcut cleared. Click Save to disable it.

invalidShortcut.message: That key cannot be used as an extension shortcut.

shortcutNeedsModifier.message: Letter and number shortcuts need Ctrl, Alt, or Command.

shortcutReady.message: Shortcut recorded. Click Save to apply it.

shortcutSaved.message: Shortcut saved. If another extension still fires, choose another combination.

shortcutConflict.message: Firefox did not register this shortcut, or the combination may be occupied. Choose another combination and save it.

shortcutManagerUnavailable.message: Could not open Firefox shortcut settings.

hideFloatingElementsLabel.message: Ignore fixed and floating elements in full-page and scrolling screenshots

hideFloatingElementsHint.message: Enabled by default. Prevents sticky search bars, floating navigation, back-to-top buttons, and similar overlays from repeating or covering the real captured content.

capSelectRegionHint.message: Drag to select an area; release to resize or annotate.

capAnnotationsAdded.message: Annotations added; copy and save will include them.

capAutoCopyFailed.message: Automatic copy failed; click to retry

capScrollJumpError.message: Page scroll position kept jumping. Capture stopped to avoid missing content; please try again.

capTooManyFrames.message: Too many capture frames; select a shorter range and retry.

capScrollGapError.message: Scroll position skipped uncaptured content; capture stopped to prevent gaps.

capNoVisibleArea.message: Unable to continue capturing the scrolling area.

capInvalidCaptureArea.message: Selection is outside the capturable area.

capNoNewContent.message: Scrolling did not reveal new content.

capIncompleteCoverage.message: Incomplete coverage; stopped to avoid missing rows in the screenshot.

capOutputTooLarge.message: Screenshot exceeds the safe image dimensions; select a shorter range.

capPageTooTall.message: Page exceeds the safe single-image height. Use scrolling capture to select a smaller area.

capCapturingFull.message: Capturing full page in fixed steps…

capScrollerTooTall.message: Scrolling area exceeds the safe image height. Use scrolling capture instead.

capCapturingInner.message: Detected an inner scroll area; capturing in fixed steps…

capSelectionTooTall.message: Selected range exceeds the safe image height; shorten the range.

capExtendHint.message: Drag the bottom edge down; auto-scroll starts near the bottom.

capLongDetailHint.message: Drag the bottom of the selection toward the lower edge to auto-scroll. Release to adjust again, then click Finish.

capLongInitialHint.message: First select the width and starting point, then drag the bottom edge down to extend.

capRangeHeight.message: Height $1 px · drag the lower edge to extend
